task_name: Place New Residential Zone, Collect Nails, and Queue Factory Production

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When a new Residential Zone slot unlocks ('1' badge on Residential menu) and finished Nails appear above the Building Supplies Store.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Keeping all available Residential Zone slots placed on the map gives more hard-hat upgrade options and maximizes population growth.
preconditions: Finished Nails on Building Supplies Store
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Place the new Residential Zone in the open lot along the main residential street.

steps.who: Residential Buildings icon on the right menu

steps.briefing: drag the zone into the gap on the residential street and click the green checkmark.

steps.who: floating Nails on the Building Supplies Store
floating Metal on the northern Small Factories
steps.briefing: collect finished Metal and queue Wood and Metal in the empty factory slots.
